method: Static read only. No food code, installer, hook, build or test was run. Food paths are relative to ingest/claude-mem/src; OAW paths are prefixed oaw-ref/. Every kept citation was re-read in source for this ledger. Verifier corrections take precedence over the digest.
food_summary:
claude-mem 15.9.0 @02584c4 (root Apache-2.0; cowork/ PolyForm-Noncommercial) is automatic, machine-local session memory: hooks capture every tool call and prompt, a background observer LLM compresses them into typed observations in SQLite FTS5 (plus a Chroma vector index), and memory is pushed back at SessionStart, at Read time and through a 26-tool MCP server. It is event-sourced personal memory, not a curated knowledge map, so it does not replace OAW's LLM wiki (wiki_sync.py).

Ledger: 8 absorb, 3 hold, 19 excrete.

Absorb (8). Each is a stdlib re-implementation inside an existing OAW part and adds no skill, hook, daemon, dependency or network call. Targets: context_hub.py recall (--index, --file with a files: field, an output data fence), memory_add guards (<private> and host-injected tags, prefixed-credential patterns, default on), oaw.py doctor (stdlib-shadowing check), improvement.py (non-vacuous verdict rule) and the catalog goldfish gate (hardened no-tool reviewer launch with an argv pin test).

Hold (3), each with the cheapest test that would decide it (D11): ranked FTS5 recall, a 'recall by file before editing' trigger, and the product's core claim that automatic compressed memory beats native host memory.

Excrete (19). The install path itself is excreted: capture of all tool I/O with redaction off, a second model runtime that reads OAuth credentials from the OS credential store, a never-idle daemon with runtime PyPI fetches, always-on SessionStart injection that overrides the host to-do tool, a PreToolUse deny of native Read, a cwd-fallback MCP loader, 30 model-invocable author skills (push/merge/release, coercive wording), default-on PostHog telemetry with a false privacy statement in a shipped skill, silent PATH/rc edits, curl|bash installers with marketplace autoUpdate, an unauthenticated localhost API, scheduled agent runs on the user's own logged-in CLIs, deliverable copies to the home dir, competition with native memory, a commercial funnel with an NC-licensed sub-plugin, and global Codex config edits. Three excretes are redundancy, not harm: the fixed type vocabulary, render-then-fit, and knowledge-agent corpora.

Corrections over the digest:
- The cross-host gate is flag/untested, not pass.
- The Setup bun install is only a conditional repair.
- Cloud sync is off only for headless installs; the interactive installer preselects CMEM Pro.
- The data-not-instructions fence exists on one path (memory-search.ts:165).
- The read-gate eval now reports -38%/-30% cost on a 49 KB file; the '+20% on Opus' figure was a 19 KB run before the 32 KB threshold. These are author-run samples of 2-3, not reproduced here.

Process note, per the owner: digesting foods is separate from building the digestion system, but this food clarifies it. Two absorbs feed the digestion system itself. The hardened reviewer recipe keeps goldfish reviewers truly tool-less and context-free. The non-vacuous verdict rule stops an A/B from passing when the mechanism never fired.

Evidence level (D12): every absorb is 'not measured' for model behavior until its fixtures or A/B run; ship at 'parity, no improvement claimed' (D2).
